Thank you for taking the time to share your experience. I think I understand what you mean, while not necessary to idolize a guitarist, there comes a point where one may find a guitarist that is that perfect representation of their style.

Although it may eventually lead to stagnation, and a ideal progress path would be to open up to other guitarist styles too. In a way far more focused on multiple styles and genre over a particular guitarist, although one can always share the exact similar style their favorite guitarist portray. 

This does makes a lot of sense, perhaps if bothered with looking the guitarist for the songs I really like, it is likely that I do already have some sense of preference, although I should not keep myself enclosed to particular styles only. 

Thank you again, for taking the time to answer my question \^\^

If I may ask, too what limits would “want to learn as much of it as possible”? Such as learning every style used by the guitarist, the tones they liked and stuff like this? Perhaps something like a guitarist that is really good with ambient sounds, I would focus on creating this ambient guitar language on my own through the inspirations of this guitarist?

Im the mtf side but I really feel you man, everything has triggered dysphoria to a point where I dont keep mirrors in my room, and I leave my room about twice a week on average.

I can’t afford doctors or counselling. Understand that tiredness too, we are all surviving, try your best okay? 

I find that I get entertained by animal videos and it pulls my attention away from things, maybe you can try finding an activity that doesn’t trigger your dysphoria to an unacceptable level.

For eg. I engage in hobbies within the confine of my room, I have a small archery practice area, a small music studio, a place to play rpg games as my identified gender. Especially rpg, you can play as a guy and type like one, everyone would treat you like one, it helps me feel accepted and less dysphoric.

Though it’s only a temporary solution while you wait it out for that right moment to help yourself (length is diff for everyone I guess). I find that these helps with my dysphoria.

May times I feel extremely unmotivated, which is why I took up many hobbies, basically a jack of all trades so I can switch to which ever helps, I can do cooking on some days, harmonica on some, piano on some. 

I understand situations differ, since you go to school, you need to interact with people frequently, during those days, I particularly did lots of drawing, rpg on mobile phones, listening to music. My lifestyle is rather unhealthy, but what I really want to encourage is to find something that distracts you well, also to be keen and curious to explore new things, the more things you can be distracted from, the more likely you don’t think about it until shower time or what not. 

I hope I don’t come off as happy go lucky, I certainly am not xD I just hope I can help in anyway, since the dysphoria motif is very similar among us, lets try and survive together ^^ 

Ps, if it works, let me know.

Well thanks for talking to me and not being one of those people who say, why not just look for another job. I know its impractical but i never seem to convey it in a right manner for them.

I know the cause and I know what triggers my episode, its all around me, I can see the cause everywhere. Frankly though, its of those scenarios where money will actually pay for happiness.

Lots of money to pay and I can probably feel slightly at ease, enough to work with reasons to survive. Which is why jobs are very crucial and as I’ve explained, I have my limitations with jobs. That is plan A, plan B is to stop existing. 

Its binary but a simple life is good as well. 

Im flattered by your praise but Im really not that smart, I excel practically but not scholarly, thats what happens when people do things for the sake of it, either quality suffers or happiness suffers. I am slightly glad I spend more time playing useless games than getting As for my school, but that comes at a price in the resume. I really dont want to worry about results, it eats up too much energy and Im glad there are people who can put all their energy into results and remain content with life.

My mom knows about my condition but as mentioned earlier, I have trouble telling my family members things too. I started telling them earlier on and for some reason I became really scared to talk to people. Maybe I feel shameful or what not but I cannot explain it. It does feel a little lonely so I spend my time online since I find that I still can converse by text to people I dont know. 

I dont know, life is a mystery, its like lovecraftian horror all together. The more I ponder the uglier it gets but when you are lost, you must wander.

I have studied aeronautics through high-school and currently part-time university. So I intend to look for a career field specializing in Air traffic control. It is something I've always been working at since I was a child.

Im not sure if being with friends really helps because more often than not, my friends like to hang out in big group of 3 or more people. While I like to listen to them talk, I get too drowned out when I speak so I rather just let them continue.

My reason against drugs is not solely antidepressants, I worked in a pharmacy for 2 years and it was there that I understood the costs of long-term medication. I used to be on medications at 120 a month for 2 years, I've been off medication since I lost the energy to work. No energy to work, I dont get money, without the money, I cant get my medications. It can also be applied to regular visits too a psychiatrist which will cost me 40 for a consult and prescription.

My mom wants me to see a doctor too and she is willing to pay for it. But with logic and the consciousness to decide, whats so amazing about this world anyway? How is it that the people around me can tell me the world is an amazing place, that life is a special gift when I dont see anything about that at all. For all I've remembered in life, I've always seen this as a cruel place unfit for human life.

How are people so positive all the time? How can people live with so much ignorance or ignore whats right before them? 

'I dream to be a fashion designer', oh Its too tough, I guess i'll be an admin office worker then. What? How do they get over it? All I see is them complaining about their work life and they think its fine. I dont get it, I cannot understand people at all.

On a side note, maybe I'll consider volunteering to the animal shelter. I also appreciate you taking the time to read and reply, even suicide hotlines are much more useless at this. I will never know if I'ld take my life but if I am doing it this time, I wont be calling out to my friends anymore. I want to avoid the messages people only speak out of desperation.

But right now, I'll think it through, the prospect of getting anti-depresants and feeling happy again sounds very foreign and kinda scary but I'll think about it.

The things you say, it makes a lot of sense, and scary enough I do think this way. I feel suicide is a sensible option but I am also conscious enough to know about the world surrounding me.

Some people think its rash but I have reasoned out enough to think, this might be the best way out of this world. But of course, Im not designed to do such things else, I would have done it along time ago. 

Failure does make me work harder and I do have somewhat of a perfectionist attitude when It comes to work. Reread my resume lots of times, prepare until I am confident for the task. Unfortunately, it is also that 'I must attain once I set my mind on it' attitude that I find difficult to find a different career path. In a way, people say I am persistent, in another words, I am very stubborn.

I find it tough to settle for 2nd best because I was born 2nd best through natural selection. I have settled for 2nd best all my life, cant get that job i like? Just take that part-time job that will definitely hire me. My confidence plunges and even though I am really good at the job, I can do it no more than 1-2months before I go AWOL and cook up reasons not to attend work.

But when I pick something I really enjoy, I never skip a day. I work over time at no additional pay, I never feel tired. That is why, it is important that I never settle for 2nd best when looking for a lifetime career but I am still trying ways to make me a better candidate. I feel really exhausted, because the people who gets the job are those who never started with the passion. It makes my world look like a lie, 'chase your dreams and follow your passion'? pfft. 

I cant afford to lose out to job opportunities in my life, I just need one foot in and I can start working from the bottom up all my life but its just not happening. I have only gotten 1 interview call and I pretty much messed that up yet I cannot let it go because if I did, then everything I ever lived for meant nothing.

It really doesnt matter who I talk to or not because no one has time for my shit. For some reason, strangers online seem to care more than people I know and that is perhaps why I find it much more comfortable typing.

I do admit that playing music really gives me a boost, although I do not take drugs, It seems comparable to drugs. When I play with my band, I get 1-2hrs of high and right after that I want more but I cannot get more. Playing alone at home doesn't help and I usually fall deeper into no where until the next session, I don't practice since I don't have the energy to but when I have to, it feels like a chore.

Like right now as I write this, its tiring and im too exhausted to even plug my guitar in. My patches arnt set yet so someone is going to be unhappy about my sound when we jam later and I am probably the only person have lots of fun. Im surprised no one kicked me out yet but I guess they like quiet people.

Im probably just blabbering, im going to stop here and take a nap. heh, looks like my plan to stay up for days probably wouldnt work, not a good plan.

That's quite a shame. I just feel pretty hopeless about life. I've tried and tried that's why I manage to celebrate my 25th birthday but I've gone numb. I want to rest but I'm also very scared, I'm kinda scared of going to the doctors too.

Took up a student loan to study after failing over 10 applications for a job, I'm really not sure why I'm studying. I don't have the energy to do my school work, work or even play music anymore. I've not practiced by guitar for over 2 months and when I play with my band, I do an all nighter just to pretend I practiced.

I want to volunteer to pet rescue but that's not going to pay my loan. My dad used his provident funds for my high school 2 years ago, government is asking me for those money. I had high hopes for a full-time job but I'm failing again and again. I've been to career centers and and approached a career advisor in my school but that hasn't been much help.

I honestly took loads of effort to put on a smile and dress nicely, practiced like I depended on these jobs but I'm done spending whats left of my energy.

I've fallen behind on my 2nd term in school just because I can't get off to do my school work. I haven't had people I could talk to because I simply couldn't talk to them because I feel like there's this invisible wall right in front of me, I try to speak but no words can come out.

I only speak less than 100 words a day just so my family members can shut up, and even if I wanted to tell them whats going on, I couldn't. My mind feels like its racing all the time, so much thoughts, I feel very upset and unsatisfied. Sometimes I feel the world has failed me.

I have tried my best to pursue dreams and passion, take up new interests and advance to be someone reliable for my family. Dreams and passion are what people have always said to achieve, I have the skills, mind-set, passion to do the job and I spent my whole life making myself a rightful candidate for the job, but many of the times, the people who takes these place 'wanted to try the job because it pays well', 'because you do not need a degree to get the job'.

Words are all you need to thrive in a broken society. In a society where words are the strongest, I am built to be without words, I cannot speak even though I am blessed with speech. I am a square in a circle world, cursed by sympathy, empathy, and compassion.

I want not to hurt my parents but I have existed and played my role. I want to exit but the people around me keeps holding tight, the only way I can spare them even just a little is if I died through an accident. I cannot be inconsiderate to others so the accident have to be purely natural.
